notes.title: Patch 0.8
notes.content:
Welcome to the patch notes! If you're more of a visual learner, check out [url=https://youtu.be/pK4NoULBqNs]patch 0.8's launch trailer[/url] if you haven't yet!

[h1]New Stuff[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]A new Arena: Welcome to [b]the Pansun[/b]!
[list]
 	[*]Stand in the [b]glowing plates of the Pansun[/b] and face all its[b] mysteries [/b]in the new Temtem: Swarm arena.[/*]
 	[*]A new zone to explore, with new Landmarks [b]closely based on its Temtem counterpart[/b], and enemies of the Fire, Earth and Crystal type.[/*]
 	[*][b]Two new mini-bosses[/b] and an [b]imposing new boss[/b], a certain ruler of the cosmos.[/*]
 	[*][b]New soundtrack pieces[/b] to bop to in this galactic environment![/*]
[/list][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/febf1c83065f7e2a69aafdb8012a06967aa58194.jpg[/img]
[list]
 	[*]New [b]playable character[/b]: [b]Pycko and Drakash[/b]!
[list]
 	[*]This [b]Earth/Fire duo[/b] are here to bring chaos and fun to your playtime![/*]
 	[*]With a fantastically chaotic Trait that burns and gives Pycko a [b]momentary Speed boost upon contact with an enemy[/b], and a new base attack that has a new, [b]double-sided targetting[/b], they're sure to make the delights of players who love to zoom around wreaking havoc.[/*]
[/list][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/b6d2be48a31e0e3788fa9e5e412e65b2a7078e98.png[/img]
[list]
 	[*][b]👥The great Kudos revival[/b]!
[list]
 	[*]We have [b]revamped and redone[/b] the Kudos menu to be [b]much simpler and easier to navigate[/b].
[list]
 	[*]Instead of the previous hexagon-ladden screen, you can now [b]see all your Kudos in one neat, easy-to-scroll list[/b].[/*]
 	[*]The Kudos are [b]still divided in categories and subcategories[/b], the same ones used previously.[/*]
 	[*]This change came forth from all your suggestions and feedback on the previous Kudos map. Thanks for sharing your opinions with us, and please keep doing so in the future![/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*][b]More information[/b] in each Kudo.
[list]
 	[*]We've changed all [b]Kudos to include the information to unlock them[/b] right off the bat, [b]except[/b] any info that might be a [b]spoiler[/b] to new players.[/*]
 	[*]You will also [b]be able to see which Kudo goes with which Skill Tree Node[/b] [b]directly from each Skill Tree[/b].[/*]
 	[*]Kudos are now shown in [b]four simple states[/b]: [b]coming soon[/b] (wait for the next update), [b]spoiler-covered[/b] (we'll give you the info but without spoilers), [b]unlocked[/b] (you've unlocked this one and are already making progress) and completed (you're done!).[/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]👥[b]In-game tracking for Kudos[/b], too!
[list]
 	[*]You can now access a mini Kudos menu to review the Kudos that are available for you to complete then and there.[/*]
 	[*]It's tailored to show you the Kudos associated with the Tem you're using and the Arena you're playing in.[/*]
 	[*]This is another frequent community request and we're happy to deliver. Keep a close eye on your progression right from the comfort of your match![/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]As an extra, we have also [b]moved some Kudos[/b] to a most fitting category. The best example would be that Kudos like "Deal x damage with y Technique" have been moved to the part of the map where said Technique is unlocked, to minimize confusion.[/*]
[/list][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/53a852c2d4f69cfb4df4fbbe5c08cbad260283cb.jpg[/img]
[list]
 	[*]👥New Setting: [b]Technique opacity[/b].
[list]
 	[*]We've added a [b]new slider in the Settings menu[/b] that lets you [b]customize the opacity of the player Techniques[/b]. Choose how intense or how subtle you want the VFX in your matches be![/*]
 	[*]To add the cherry on top, you will also see your [b]co-op partners' Techniques[/b] in the [b]same opacity you have set for yourself[/b]. Take this practical example: if player A has set their opacity to 25%, they will see player B's Techniques at 25% opacity; if player B has set their opacity to 72%, they will see player A's Techniques at 72% opacity. Control your screen all the way![/*]
 	[*]Although we've been listening to your feedback and manually adjusting some Techniques to[b] improve visibility[/b], it was clear that a broader step had to be taken, so we're giving you [b]complete choice over Technique transparency[/b]. We hope this change will alleviate most of the issues our players have with visibility, but we'll still be alert to take any extra measure or work on it if need be.[/*]
[/list][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/db27ec61cf1bf92687d514810e9b17a46e36221b.jpg[/img]
[list]
 	[*]A new [b]Stat: Dodge[/b].
[list]
 	[*]Dodge symbolizes the [b]chance[/b] a player has [b]of dodging any instance of damage.[/b][/*]
 	[*]To start dodging, please first [b]unlock the pertinent Skill Tree Node[/b] for all the Tems you want to be dodging with.[/*]
 	[*]Dodge[b] covers all damage[/b], including proyectiles, attacks, damage areas, minibosses' and bosses' kits, etc.[/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*][b]👥Cursor customization![/b]
[list]
 	[*]Both the [b]in-game cursor and the aiming pointer[/b] can now be customized in two different ways: [b]shape and size[/b].[/*]
 	[*]Choose from a[b] variety of shapes and colors[/b] in the shape selector and pick the one that's best for you.[/*]
 	[*]Once you have your shape decided, [b]choose from a range of sizes[/b], from small to big, until your cursor is just perfect.[/*]
 	[*]This feature, which is also community-rquested, is also framed as part of our efforts to [b]make visibility in Temtem: Swarm better for everyone[/b]. We hope you will all find a cursor you like, or at least one you don't lose track of during the fray![/*]
[/list][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/63afc93f532f5da1904e8ef603216f34ad2d03e4.jpg[/img]
[list]
 	[*][b]New Hacking modifiers![/b]
[list]
 	[*]Add more spice to your challenge with [b]5 new Hacking level modifiers[/b] that you can mix and match during the Hacking Mode selector: Pick-ups that [b]disappear[/b] after a bit, extra [b]mini-Bosses[/b], and enemies that have an [b]increasable chance[/b] of [b]exploding[/b], leaving [b]waste[/b] pools behind or being [b]shielded[/b]. Have fun![/*]
[/list][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/c1e0557f0bd691dfedf79f29e4adb555b69862e5.jpg[/img]
[list]
 	[*][b]New Gears![/b]
[list]
 	[*][b]Spyglass[/b].
[list]
 	[*]This new Gear [b]increases the damage[/b] that [b]enemies with any Status condition receive[/b]. Perfect for the new playable Tem![/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*][b]Kaleidotonic[/b]
[list]
 	[*]This new Gear [b]increases the damage dealt by Status Conditions[/b]. Also perfect for the new evo line![/*]
[/list][/*][/list][/*]
 	[*][b]7 new Glitches [/b]to delight our challenge-oriented players.[/*]
 	[*]New [b]Dash tutorial[/b]!
[list]
 	[*]This tutorial will pop up for new players who have Unlocked Oree but haven't unlocked the Kudo that allows other Tems to have a Dash node in the Skill Tree.[/*]
 	[*]Many new players wonder how to get the Dash for other Tems that aren't Oree, who comes with a built in Dash. This tutorial should help with that![/*]
 	[*]To pair up with this change, we've adjusted it so if you have an Oree egg among other eggs, the [b]Oree egg will always be the one to hatch first[/b]. That way we can introduce the Dash and the new Dash tutorial to new players as soon as possible.[/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]Returning pickup: [b]Mayhem Drive[/b].
[list]
 	[*]All fun, no cooldowns! This pickup causes your Tem to spam [b]all their Techs without any cooldown[/b] for five seconds.[/*]
 	[*]We're aware that Mayhem Drive found its way into the game on patch 0.7[/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]New [b]Steam achievements[/b] to complete![/*]
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]👥We've made some improvements and QoL changes to the Pause menu:
[list]
 	[*]You can now see the[b] interactions between Perks[/b] by hovering over any Perk. This means which Gears affect what Techniques, and vice versa.[/*]
 	[*]We've added [b]text[/b] to the Pause buttons so that it's easier to identify what each of them does.[/*]
 	[*]You can now[b] see your Temtem's Trait description[/b] in the Pause menu.[/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]Use your[b] right-click[/b] button to [b]leave[/b] or exit any menu!
[list]
 	[*]It will now work like the ESC button for all UIs.[/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]👥[b]Floor is lava[/b] has gotten further [b]improvements to better its visibility[/b] with a [b]new upwards VFX[/b], and a [b]much bigger ball[/b]. We hope this change, along with the change in Technique opacity, will make this spot less troublesome for you![/*]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/da3f2a03acaa2cfc3637663dde5df70da3052d67.jpg[/img]
[list]
 	[*]👥We've created a [b]distinction on the Synergy menu[/b] during a match to differentiate between [b]unlocked and undiscovered Synergies[/b].
[list]
 	[*]Synergies that you haven't[b] unlocked[/b] yet (you haven't found the right Kudo nor have you leveled up the base Technique to level 5) show with a [b]lock[/b] symbol.[/*]
 	[*]Synergies that you haven't[b] discovered[/b] yet (you've completed the Kudo, but you've never used this Synergy and don't know the recipe yet) now show with an [b]interrogation mark[/b].[/*]
[/list][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/f347fd27f71370c791eee89e9b4f1d71b21503d8.png[/img]
[list]
 	[*]👥We've added [b]map markers for pick-up items[/b], just like the ones fruits have. This includes speed Boots, invincible Armor, chips, etc.[/*]
 	[*]If you're at full health but had turned on the setting to autoselect a healing item upon level up, the[b] healing item will now spawn[/b] in the map as a pick-up.[/*]
 	[*]The [b]Glitches tab will now be hidden[/b] in the End of the Run screen [b]if we haven't picked any Glitch[/b] during the match.[/*]
 	[*]We've reworked the [b]Tem selector[/b] in the Skill Trees so that it would match the pre-game one.[/*]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/edb177d622df249fbbf9e605ef808c2332645b83.jpg[/img]
[list]
 	[*]We've reviewed all the [b]UI[/b] bits across Temtem: Swarm to [b]improve[/b] them and make sure they were [b]cohesive and accurate[/b].[/*]
 	[*]We've made some extra [b]performance adjustments[/b] and [b]UX improvements[/b] to the new Kudos section so that it's smooth to navigate.[/*]
 	[*]We've added [b]Steam timeline markers[/b] for the new mini-bosses and boss.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Balance[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
 	[*][b]Dash Damage[/b] now [b]scales based on the playable Temtem's damage[/b].
[list]
 	[*]As opposed to being a fixed number, damage will now be dynamic and tied to the player's Damage.[/*]
 	[*]In-game descriptions of Skills have been adjusted following this change.[/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*][b]Damage numbers[/b] shown in the End of the Run screen have been [b]adjusted[/b] and will now only [b]show the damage used to defeat the enemy Tem[/b].
[list]
 	[*]Before, the whole damage dealt by the Technique was counted, even if only a 10% of that had already defeated the enemy Tem. This was causing [b]visible imbalance[/b] between Techs that hit bluntly and Techs that deal damage through Status Conditions, because the latter only ever user as much damage as it was needed to defeat the enemy.[/*]
 	[*]To equalize this across the board on the EoR screen, the damage numbers shown will be[b] those used to defeat the enemy, but not the surplus[/b].[/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]All Skill Trees' optional caps have been[b] uncapped further[/b].[/*]

notes.title: We grew up fearing Quicksand. Pycko was born to wield it!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Tamers! [/h1][p]
Pycko and its evolution Drakash are crashing into [i]Temtem: Swarm[/i] with fire in their paws and earth under their claws. These two aren’t here to play nice: they’re here to blaze trails, shake the ground, and make sure no swarm survives unscathed. Their scrappy hit-and-run energy and new Earth techniques are built to bury the competition.[/p][p][/p][h2]Pycko 101[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/47ba9d40f08ee0205b80e38a30f3c615d65190c9.png"][/img][/p][p]Pycko is all about balancing reckless flames with clever positioning. Every time it makes physical contact, it leaves enemies burning and gains a quick burst of speed to slither out of trouble. This fiery hit-and-run identity makes Pycko feel like a burning bowling ball bouncing across the battlefield. Hard to pin (get it?) down, even harder to ignore.[/p][p][/p][h2]Let's Talk Techs[/h2][p]Right out of the gate, Pycko comes with [b]Earth Drill[/b], its signature starting move. Two earthen drills sprout on either side of Pycko, chewing through enemies and dealing steady damage as you come in contact with the swarm. It’s a perfect tool for carving out space when the swarm closes in.[/p][p]Don’t worry though, Pycko hasn’t forgotten its Fire roots. It can tap into the full arsenal of Fire techniques as well, giving it the flexibility to scorch wide groups or snipe key threats as needed.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Earth Techniques[/b][/h3][p][b]Sludge Gift:[/b] A nasty surprise that tunnels underground before erupting in an area-wide blast. Enemies think they’re safe until it pops up beneath their feet. Boom! Taste sludge, punk![/p][p][b]Quicksand:[/b] A control tool that leaves a sticky pit, pulling enemies toward the center while slowing them down. Great for setting up combos with teammates or keeping threats off your back.[/p][previewyoutube="kpImbyDI8x8;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]What about that Ultimate?[/h2][p]When Pycko really gets cooking, it unleashes its [b]Hot Sand Bath[/b] ultimate. Pycko glows from a sudden increase in temperature, raising its defense significantly while punishing anyone who dares get close. Every contact deals damage in addition to getting burned by Pycko’s trait. It’s like standing too close to a furnace that just came to life and the perfect moment where Pycko goes from prey to predator.[/p][previewyoutube="cSZJMmXiR2E;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Shattered Eclipse patch drops on [b]September 22nd[/b]! Are you excited to try out Pycko in just a few days? Let us know in the comments![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2510960/Temtem_Swarm/?utm_source=post&utm_campaign=evergreen&utm_medium=steam"][/dynamiclink][/p][h1]See you in the Swarm, Tamers![/h1]

notes.title: Patch 0.8: launch date, spoilers, and more!
notes.content:
[p]Hi Tamers! We've been quietly working on the next update, patch 0.8, but we think it's safe now to chat about it a bit, even to provide a launch date! ([i]knocks on wood)[/i][/p][h2]First of all, a date[/h2][p]Temtem: Swarm's 0.8 patch will launch on [b]September 22nd[/b] if everything continues going according to plan! With that out of the way, let us show you some of the beauty that we have in store for you this time!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/94a8d5e1c97da87dc897314689aa7cdcc76e368c.png"][/img][/p][h2]Shattered Eclipse[/h2][p]Patch 0.8's formal name is [b]Shattered Eclipse[/b], which might already give you some clues as to where we're going and who we're meeting, but if it doesn't ring a bell yet, good! We'll be posting map spoilers tomorrow >:)

A great focus of ours in this patch was to give players more control over their Temtem: Swarm, as well as improving visibility across the board. While we won't share all our tricks yet, we can tell you about one great change we did: as per your requests, we've added [b]a new slider in the Settings menu[/b] that let's you [b]alter the transparency of your Techs[/b], allowing you to make them less intrusive if they bother you.[/p][p] Following all the received community feedback, we've been manually adjusting many individual Techniques, trying to make them less intrusive, but at the end of that road we figured: why not let you peeps choose that? So you can now control how intense you'd like to see Player Techniques! You will also see the Techs from your co-op partners with the opacity you've set for yourself, meaning that if your opacity is set to 30%, you will see your partners' Techs at 30% opacity, while if they have it at 100% they will see your at 100%! All the choice with as little intrusiveness as possible! [/p][previewyoutube="6NUI3Z7Tp_U;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
And speaking of customization, would thou like to live more challengingly? Challenge yourself to the max with 5 new Hacking level modifiers: [b]extra Minibosses, dissappearing pickups and enemies with a chance to leave waste pools, explode or be shielded.[/b] [/p][previewyoutube="VnT11sv4nr4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
We also wanted to bring back Mayhem Drive, although it seems it had bypassed our filters and is in the game since 0.7. If you hadn't noticed it yet, it's a [b]fantastic pick-up[/b] that releases all Techniques with [b]no cooldown during 5 seconds[/b]. Keep an eye out for it from now on!


These are all the spoilers we can share about 0.8 for now, but remember there's a [b]new playable Temtem coming, new Techs, a new Arena with a new boss and mini-bosses, an entirely revamped Kudos system and menu, more QoL changes, balance bug fixes and more[/b]. And what's best? Plenty of that came from your suggestions, so it's extra especial!
See you around for some more spoilers, Tamers, but until then...

have fun and Temtem up! ːtemloveːːswburnː[/p]

notes.title: Another step forward! Check out the July edition of our living roadmap!
notes.content: [h1]Hello, Tamers![/h1][p][/p][p]We hope you're doing great in the intense summer temperatures. One day more, we gather here to talk about the upcoming future for Temtem: Swarm, as we've been doing [b]after every big update[/b].  [/p][p]Endless Inferno has been a fierce patch, with our [b]first-ever Fire Tem, Raiber[/b], the [b]Kisiwa arena[/b] and the endless (hehe) entertainment that are the [b]Hacking Levels[/b]. With the blazes of 0.7 and it's companion, 0.7.1, still burning bright, we can pause and take a look into our [b]next big content update, 0.8[/b], and further! So here's a recap of the more substantial changes coming to your Swarms in the near future.  [/p][p]As usual, remember that, while we're posting it and it is totally official, [b]everything here is still subject to change, be replaced or be rescheduled.[/b]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/563d24bc7f907772bfe27ca38deacefc82c449f0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you're familiar with us and our future plans, you know [b]we don't include any sort of dates[/b], and we try to [b]keep things open to possible changes[/b]. But if you're familiar with our vibes, you know [b]there'll be many spoilers as the time gets closer[/b]![/p][p] We don't have a name for the next update just yet, but [b]we'd love to hear your wild guesses on it[/b]! What [b]Arena[/b] and [b]new playable Tem[/b] do you guess the 0.8 version will contain? We'll be checking your replies in our social media and Discord server.[/p][p] As usual, there will be [b]new Techniques, Synergies and Gears[/b], but there will also be [b]more and better Hacking Levels[/b] to explore and conquer! Plus [b]new Glitches[/b] to really put yourself to the test.[/p][p] We're really paying attention to [b]issues brought up by our community[/b] (you!) in previous patches, so there's a focus on addressing areas that were mentioned by the community. You can identify all the community-suggested changes thanks to the little 👥 icon! [b]Kudos are getting improved and revamped[/b], with new [b]in-game tracking[/b] for them and a complete [b]overhaul of the Kudos section[/b] to improve legibility and accessibility. [b]The Floor is Lava[/b], a spot that has been often brought up as hard to see, is also getting improved to tackle this issue players have. And, in the same vein of making the game as pleasing and comfortable for players as possible, we'll be creating settings to [b]customize your cursor[/b] in 0.8 too![/p][p]Remember Temtem: Swarm is still in Early Access, and as such, open to your feedback and suggestions! Please let us know your ideas and suggestions [url="https://discord.gg/DjjAmydpeb"]through our Discord server[/url]; please search around first to see if someone else has proposed the same thing. We do our best to read everything, even though we cannot reply to the majority of it, and it helps us shape Temtem: Swarm into a fantastic game. [b]Thank you for your energy and help![/b] [/p][p]With every new update we get closer to a better Temtem: Swarm! Thank you for all your support so far: we hope you'll continue to enjoy Temtem: Swarm in the future!   [/p][p][/p][p]Until then, have fun Tamers! And…[/p][h1]Temtem up![/h1]

notes.title: Patch 0.7.1
notes.content:
[h1]Important Notice
[/h1][list]
 	[*]The [b]Temtem: Swarm demo is back[/b]!
[list]
 	[*]You'll be able to play the [b]Cipanku arena[/b] with [b]Platypet, Smazee and Oree[/b].[/*]
 	[*][b]Any progress you make in the demo will transfer to the full game[/b] when you purchase it.[/*]
 	[*][b]Demo players are able to play with players from the full version[/b], as long as they're playing on the Arenas available in the Demo and without Challenge Modes.[/*]
 	[*]If your friends are on the fence about picking it up, please [b]let them know they can now try the game entirely for free[/b]![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h1]New stuff
[/h1][list]
 	[*]We're introducing [b]4 new Neutral Techniques[/b] that [b]can be used by all Tems[/b].
[list]
 	[*]They're Rotten Zone, Rainbow Guard, Expanding Force and Darkness.[/*]
 	[*]Each of these also has a synergy associated.[/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]👥On top of this, [b]all Temtem have gained access to previously-existing Neutral Techs[/b].
[list]
 	[*]This will effectively [b]duplicate the Tech Pools of all Temtem[/b], and should help make runs more unique with the broader range of Techs.[/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]We've added [b]connection indicators to lobbies[/b].
[list]
 	[*]We already had them on the lobby explorer, but now you'll also be able to see the strength of your connection with the host even in private lobbies.[/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]Created [b]new Kudos[/b] for the new Neutral Techniques.[/*]
 	[*]We've added a little [b]invulnerability time after levelling up and choosing a perk[/b], similar to the one we get after evolving.[/*]
 	[*]👥We've added a [b]new option[/b] for players with a [b]full build [/b]to[b] auto-select their perks[/b].
[list]
 	[*]When your build is full, the next level up will [b]show you a checkbox to auto-select either Pansuns or health items[/b].[/*]
 	[*]Once you make your choice [b]it will stay that way until the end of the match[/b].[/*]
[/list][/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/302558efcc33e247434fab114ed922264a7a29a0.png[/img]
[list]
 	[*]👥Likewise, we've [b]introduced a setting to skip[/b] the animation and [b]automatically get all rewards[/b] out of chests for players who have a full build.
[list]
 	[*]Like with Perks, players will need to [b]check a box while picking a chest[/b] so the change can be applied on all chests moving forwards.[/*]
 	[*]Pickable items, like the speed boots, Magnets or the invulnerability shield, will [b]spawn on the map[/b] so the player can pick them up when they desire.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]We've added a [b]new pop-up[/b] the [b]first time you visit the Skill Tree of a newly unlocked Temtem[/b].
[list]
 	[*]It will display the info on how many Linked Pansuns you have in that Skill Tree.[/*]
 	[*]Linked Pansuns are Pansuns that can only be spent in that particular Skill Tree. They are used first when upgrading Skill Tree Nodes.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]👥We've focused a lot of efforts in this patch on [b]tackling the issues with pool dilution[/b]:
[list]
 	[*]To start with, we've [b]increased the chance[/b] of getting perks that[b] synergize[/b] with any of [b]your equipped perks[/b].
[list]
 	[*][b]You must have the synergy unlocked for this to happen. [/b]Make sure you complete many Kudos to unlock everything![/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]We have further [b]lowered the chance[/b] of [b]perks that you don't select[/b] from [b]appearing in further level ups[/b].[/*]
 	[*]We've[b] increased the chances of getting 4 perk slots[/b] when we have a full build.
[list]
 	[*]This was previously only based on the Luck skill, but now we have [b]added a 40% base bonus to it[/b].[/*]
 	[*]With enough Luck skill, the [b]possibilty can grow to reach a 100% chance[/b].[/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]The base probability of Techs showing on the level up when the player has all their Tech slots filled has been [b]reduced to a 20%[/b], so the possibility of [b]being offered a Gear goes up to 80%.[/b][/*]
 	[*]We have [b]increased the number of blocks, rerolls and snoozes to 5 each[/b].[/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]We have set some measures to prevent and control the issue [b]causing players who had suffered a crash to experience corrupt save files[/b].
[list]
 	[*]We'll still be closely monitoring to ensure swift action if something comes up.[/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]We've take some measures to [b]improve and[/b] [b]prevent performance issues on Hasty and Endless Mode[/b],
[list]
 	[*]We've given a performance review pass to Swarm enemies and fixed a past mishap, which will improve performance across the board.[/*]
 	[*]We've set a [b]soft cap on the amount of Swarm enemies shown on screen[/b].
[list]
 	[*]Undefeated enemies that would normally re-spawn around the player character will now de-spawn if the cap has been reached.[/*]
 	[*]This only affects normal Swarm enemies, and [b]doesn't affect bosses, mini-bosses or powerful enemies[/b].[/*]
[/list][/*][/list][/*]
 	[*]👥We have given [b]map visibility a complete review pass[/b]:
[list]
 	[*]We've [b]shrunken or moved map elements[/b], such as rocks on the borders of the Arenas.[/*]
 	[*]We've [b]added transparency to props and elements[/b] that are scattered around the map, so that if players come close to them they can still see through.[/*]
 	[*]With this we hope to improve the visibility players have during their runs, and to prevent the player character from disappearing behind obstacles.[/*]
[/list][/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/df76b2c353b408ca61516098fda6fdf141c7c305.jpg[/img]
[list]
 	[*]We've added a blinking effect to the markers to the No Hit and Art Restoration spots so they're easier to complete.[/*]
 	[*]We're making changes to prevent the HUD being hidden in the Settings for returning players.
[list]
 	[*]All [b]HUDs will now be toggled ON by default[/b], but you can turn them off in the Settings Menu.[/*]
 	[*]If you had set your HUD off on Settings, you will need to redo this again after this patch. Apologies for the inconveniences.[/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]We've [b]increased the width of the Temtem selection menu box[/b] so that you have to scroll less.[/*]
 	[*]We've removed the check symbol on the Swarm map selection to avoid confusion.[/*][/list]
[h1]Balance
[/h1][list]
 	[*]We've [b]greatly increased the amount of Pansuns that newly unlocked Tems receive[/b].
[list]
 	[*]If you had already unlocked said Tems, [b]you'll get the extra Pansuns when you log in[/b].[/*]
 	[*]These Pansuns will be tied to the Temtem you receive them on and will only be usable in that Temtem's Skill Tree.[/*]
 	[*]You can see the change for each Temtem lower below.[/*]
 	[*]This change will drastically improve the grind required to enjoy a new Temtem. Go ahead and give them all a try![/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]We've adjusted the [b]Pansuns received from rejecting a Glitch in Co-op[/b] so they take into account the number of players in the run.[/*]
 	[*]We've [b]reworked Experience Chests[/b] so that they better adapt to the momentum of the match.
[list]
 	[*]This means the further you're in a match, the more experience these chests will drop.[/*]
 	[*]From minute 15 onwards, the experience rewards already overcome the maximum reward you could get before.[/*]
[/list][/*]
 	[*]👥We've corrected the damage multiplier when using a technique that's both effective and ineffective against a double-type Temtem.

notes.title: Some of the actions we're taking to heed your feedback: peek into patch 0.7.1!
notes.content:
Hello, Tamers!
We've been carefully [b]listening to your feedback[/b] on some aspects Temtem: Swarm could improve upon, and we've [b]crafted some changes[/b] to better said aspects. 
Since we understand they directly affect your enjoyment of the game, w[b]e've made a push to have these changes be included in patch 0.7.1[/b], which should be coming out [b]late July[/b]. Many of these changes are[b] focused on alleviating the dilution of the pool[/b] and [b]improving the RNG feel[/b] as we continue creating new Techs and Gears. Here's a "small" sneak peek into some of the changes coming!

To start off, we will[b] increase the chances of getting perks that synergize with any of your currently held perks[/b]. This means that [b]if you have the Technique for a synergy, you will be more likely to see the Gear that matches with it[/b] to create a synergy, and vice versa. Please do keep in mind you'll need to have the [b]Synergy unlocked[/b] for this to happen, so complete as many Kudos as you can!
We are aware that many of you would like to enjoy more Synergies during your Swarm runs, so with this change Synergies will become more common!

Next we'll [b]further lower the chances for perks that you ignore to appear in following level ups[/b]. While our hearts were in the right place with this change, we've heard your feedback that it was hard to actually feel, so [b]we'll be making ignored perks less likely to appear each time they are ignored[/b]. By[b]increasing the percentage[/b] in which unpicked Perks lose appearance chances, [b]Snoozes are going to become really helpful[/b] when you have to choose between 2 strong Perks.

Moving on, we will also [b]lower the base probability of Techniques appearing in the level up section when your Tech slots are filled[/b]. It will be [b]reduced to a 20%[/b], instead of the current 50%.

And! We will [b]increase the chances that you get 4 perks offered to you when you have a full build[/b]. This[b] used to be entirely dependent on your Luck skill[/b], but we're adding [b]a 35% base bonus to it[/b]. This means that by then, if you have enough of the Luck skill, [b]you could reach a 100% chance[/b] of getting 4 perk slots.

To top this all off, we'll be[b] increasing the number of rerolls, blocks and snoozes to five (5)[/b]!

On a different aspect, [b]we'll be adding 4 totally new Neutral Techniques[/b], as well as [b]giving all Tems access to currently existing Neutral Techs[/b]. This will [b]essentially duplicate[/b] the amount of Techs each Tem has access to, and we [b]hope this will improve the variety that can be enjoyed in runs[/b]. We've heard your complaints that runs felt somewhat similar, even with different Tems, because the current Temtem didn't have that many Techniques. With this we'll be giving you [b]new tools to explore and play with[/b]!

We also wanted to address the frustration some of you feel when faced with having to raise a Temtem's Skill Tree from zero after unlocking it. To this end, we'll be be [b]raising x6 the amount of Pansuns a Tem starts with[/b], all Tems! To give you a practical example, Crystle now has 5000 Pansuns for you to upgrade its Skill Tree once you get it, but once patch 0.7.1 launches, [b]you will have a nifty 32000 Pansuns to start with[/b] on Crystle's Skill Tree, which will surely make those beginnings way less rocky!

But of course,[b] these are not all the changes coming in patch 0.7.1! [/b]There's some more Quality of Life changes, improvements, balance, and bug fixes, so please look forward to the full patch notes![b] We'll share a definitive date once we have one[/b], stay tuned!

We hope these changes will [b]help improve on these issues[/b] you've been communicating to us as of late, and that they'll make you [b]enjoy Temtem: Swarm more[/b]! If you like the game right now, or if you like these changes, please remember to [b]leave us a nice review on Steam[/b]. We hate to sound uncool, but it helps a lot!

notes.title: Patch 0.7
notes.content:
[h1]New Stuff[/h1][list][*][p]New Arena: [b]Kisiwa[/b][/p][list][*][p]Welcome to the [b]fierce Kisiwa[/b], a map that perfectly intertwines [b]fire and ice[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]A [b]new zone[/b] to explore, [b]new landmarks[/b] to discover that will bring a lot of nostalgia to old Temtem players, and [b]new enemy Tems[/b] to fight and conquer.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New audio tracks[/b] to match this beautiful land of contrasts.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/e98f487dee80f7d1a0ed24656f3755416555d24a.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]A [b]new playable Temtem: Raiber![/b][/p][list][*][p]Raiber and its fierce evo line are here to bring the Fire type onto the map! Please welcome the[b] first ever Fire-type playable[/b] Tem onto Swarm![/p][/*][*][p]With a [b]Trait that makes it more damaging the lower its health is[/b], Raiber is a spicy fireball for the daredevils out there. Although, if you’re more into a calm pace, you’ll soon discover Raiber has a [b]Nature-type, utility[/b] side to it as well![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/efc2ca4d2081c4039adfdfbeea4dd5efee50d6d7.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]A new boss![/b][/p][list][*][p]Of course, with a new Arena come [b]two new mini-bosses and one big boss[/b]. Without spoiling it for you, all three bosses in this stage are [b]big, strong and beefy[/b]! Plus experience [b]new weather effects[/b] caused by this Boss’ elemental type.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]The[b] Challenge Modes[/b] are here:[/p][list][*][p]Challenge modifiers, or [b]Hacking Levels[/b], which is their in-game name, are [b]adjustments players can do to their Temtem: Swarm runs[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Players can [b]add and remove Hacking Modifiers[/b] at will, crafting a [b]unique experience every time[/b], perfectly catered to their liking.[/p][/*][*][p]Adding Hacking Modifiers will increase the Hacking level: the [b]higher the Hacking level is, the more your rewards will multiply[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]You will find [b]there’s an initial limit to the Hacking level[/b] you can set for an Arena: [b]clear the Arena in that Hacking level to unlock further Hacking levels[/b], and so on! You [b]won’t be able to save[/b] your Hacking configuration [b]if you’re over your current limit[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]There are [b]currently 10 available modifiers[/b] that you can mix and match, from simple ones, like [b]lowering your Health or increasing the Swarm’s health[/b], to complex ones likes [b]Endless [/b]and [b]Hasty[/b].[/p][list][*][p][b]Endless[/b]: Play infinite cycles of waves after waves! Only your own ability will determine how far you get. Each wave will be tougher than the one before, so stay on your toes![/p][/*][*][p][b]Hasty: [/b]Crank up that speed! The Hasty modifier propels the match’s timer, making enemies appear faster which in turn snowballs into crazy runs with crazy speed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]To [b]unlock Hacking levels[/b] for an Arena, you must first [b]defeat the Arena boss in less than 40 seconds[/b]![/p][/*][*][p][b]Only the host[/b] of a match can [b]adjust and save Hacking modifiers[/b] in a lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]reward modifiers for the Hacking Levels[/b] also [b]account for each Arena’s own Pansun multiplier[/b], which means you’ll earn even more Pansuns from playing Hacking Modes on difficult Arenas.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/94fae44e16ef4986196fb9700ff9c418153c5c3f.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]👥Co-op Lobbies[/b] have gotten [b]overhauled[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Available, public lobbies are now shown in a list with all their information, and players can choose to join the one they prefer.[/p][/*][*][p]Apart from the Arena, chosen Tem, shared EXP or not, etc, the lobbies will now display they quality of the connection between you and the host of that match, letting you choose the ones that will ensure better latency and better performance.[/p][/*][*][p]You [b]won’t be able to see public lobbies[/b] that are [b]too far away[/b] from you, that have chosen an [b]Arena you haven’t unlocked yet[/b], or that have a [b]Hacking level over your current limit[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The list of lobbies automatically [b]refreshes every 2 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The previous system also works, so you can still join lobbies through a code if you so desire, and create private lobbies for you and your friends[/p][/*][*][p]We hope this new take on lobbies is closer to what our players had in mind![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/8650929cd1a82b1d6e18ff80530f2fbcff22de94.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]We’ve also added [b]information about the quality of your connection[/b] through some icons on the right side of your screen at the beginning of a run.[/p][list][*][p]If you see this icons at the beginning of the match, please be aware that lag can happen, and that lag can lead to issues during the run. Try looking for people you have a better connection with if this happens.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]A[b] ping system![/b][/p][list][*][p]No voice chat? No problem! [b]Communicate[/b] your needs to your co-op partners [b]with the new ping system[/b], that will let you choose from 10 preset expressions to convey different things![/p][/*][*][p]The available pings are: [b]Help!, Hello!, Thanks!, Good job!, Follow me, Need healing, Ultimate Status[/b] (which shows if your Ultimate is available or not), [b]Confirm, Disagree and Doubt[/b] (which can be used near pick-ups and spots to ask contextualized questions, with the icon changing to represent what the question is about).[/p][/*][*][p]When pings happen outside of your screen they will appear like spots or pick-ups do, with the [b]animation[/b] to really capture your eye. Pings also have a [b]sound effect[/b] so you don’t miss any![/p][/*][*][p]Please [b]don’t try to spam pings[/b]! There is a [b]cooldown system[/b] in place that will prevent you from using them if you overuse them. If you insist, the [b]cooldown[/b] will become increasingly [b]longer[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]You can also [b]mute other players’ pings[/b] from your own wheel of pings.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/1ef720d9f6c091ae0169fa87bce7ab4387a024e0.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]👥More [b]control over perk choice[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Snooze[/b][/p][list][*][p]Just like you do with your alarm clock, put a Perk to [b]sleep[/b] if it’s not the right time, but you still want to pick it next time.[/p][/*][*][p]The Perk will disappear from the level up menu, and be [b]guaranteed to appear the next time you level up[/b]. If you don’t pick up after the Snooze it is not guaranteed to pop up in following level ups.[/p][/*][*][p]You can [b]unlock Snooze through the Kudo Beat at least x Spots on Saipark in a single match[/b]. For those who had already unlocked this Kudo, Snooze will be [b]retroactively added[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Decreased appearance[/b][/p][list][*][p]When you don’t select an upgrade (by selecting another or doing a reroll), the [b]upgrades that weren’t selected will see their appearance probability lowered[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Although this chance will start small, it will [b]steadily grow until it reaches a threshold[/b], that will [b]vary depending on whether the upgrade is equipped[/b] or not.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/a059aa39451e9da5043f472a7670b5e00985d46b.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Experience [b]cinematics[/b]![/p][list][*][p]We’ve added cinematics at the [b]start of every match[/b], with each Temtem having its own, [b]unique[/b] one. Play with every Tem to discover all of them![/p][/*][*][p]We’ve also added cinematics for when your [b]Temtem faints[/b] and the [b]match ends[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve also added cinematics at the [b]victorious end of a match[/b]! All enemies faint, the Boss gets a closeup of being defeated, and their Pansun rewards fly all around![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/fb5caa9f084fbae506a3bd12da84d0fd38adf14d.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]👥We’ve added a new [b]Ultimate indicator[/b] right in the [b]comfort of your HUD[/b]![/p][list][*][p]Now you will also be able to see if a Gear or Glitch affects it, as it will be [b]highlighted[/b] like the rest of Techniques are.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We’ve added [b]8 new glitches[/b]![/p][list][*][p]Gain a Tech Slot, but the cooldown of your Ultimate increases 300%.[/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown of your Ultimate decreases 40%, but you lose a Tech Slot.[/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown of your Dash decreases 3 seconds, but you lose 50% of your Armor.[/p][/*][*][p]Earn 50% more Pansuns, but lose 50% of your Max HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Status Conditions you inflict last 80% more, but their damage is reduced a 40%.[/p][/*][*][p]Status Conditions you inflict damage 80% more, but their duration is reduced a 40%.[/p][/*][*][p]Your Critical Damage hurts 100% more, but the rest of damage hurts 90% less.[/p][/*][*][p]You heal 1 HP for every enemy killed, but your Armor is reduced a 100%.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Saipark waves[/b] with Neutral and Fire type enemies![/p][/*][*][p]More [b]Kudos[/b]![/p][list][*][p]Discover new Kudos for Kisiwa, for Raiber, for the fire type and for the new Techniques that have been added to the game![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New [b]Steam achievements[/b].[/p][list][*][p]Of course, with new Kudos come new [b]Steam[/b] Achievements for you to complete and flaunt![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Audio for status conditions[/b]![/p][list][*][p]We’ve added[b] audio effects[/b] to the [b]damage caused by Status Conditions[/b]. Discover each one while playing![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Improvements[/h1][list][*][p]👥We have [b]reworked some synergies following player feedback[/b] that they felt weaker than their normal counterpart.[/p][list][*][p]Here are all the synergies reworked: Water Blade +, Ignis Fatuus +, Fluid Barrier +, Sparkling Bullet +, Toxic Waste +, Glass Blade +, DC Beam +, Pollution +, Fierce Claw +, Psy Wave + and Tornado +.[/p][/*][*][p]You can read more about these changes in the [b]Balance section[/b] of these patch notes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]👥We have reworked [b]Quartz Shield [/b]so that the shield only breaks when the player is hit, instead of when the shield was hit. The shield doesn't have a collision anymore.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]👥Glitches will now [b]highlight[/b] the [b]Techs that are buffed[/b] by it. Hover over the Glitch to check it out.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/35840cdd56d7343390aa3c2498d40a304be535f8.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]👥Likewise, Glitches will now show a [b]debuff highlight[/b] to those Techs affected by it.[/p][list][*][p]There also exists the [b]combination of a buff and debuff[/b], which is shown in a yellow color.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We’ve improved the [b]post-match flow[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]You’ll now have a little [b]loading screen[/b] while the stats load, instead of staring at the galaxy.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Glitches[/b] will now be shown in the[b] End of the Run screen[/b]! You’ll be able to see how much time you’ve had each Glitch for.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We've improved the [b]visual animation of Archer enemies' projectiles[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]We've added a very cool [b]Parallax effect[/b] to many menu screens.[/p][/*][*][p]We've added [b]visual icons[/b] to the[b] description[/b] of many [b]old Techniques[/b] that didn't have them.[/p][/*][*][p]The borders of the Arenas now have a [b]new barrier effect[/b], for extra visibility! And we've improved the way the [b]map borders[/b] look.[/p][/*][*][p]For better immersion, the [b]music and ambience[/b] for an arena will now start playing in the [b]loading screen[/b] before the match begins.[/p][/*][*][p]We've improved the visual [b]fracture in the text line[/b] for Glitches.[/p][/*][*][p]We've removed the [b]redundant[/b] number of Pansuns earned and enemies defeated from the Pause menu. They still appear at the [b]bottom right of your screen[/b]![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Balance[/h1][list][*][p]👥We have [b]lowered the requirements of the Dash Kudo[/b].[/p][list][*][p]You will [b]only need to use it once[/b] (remember that Oree comes with a built-in Dash) to complete the Kudo, thus gaining access to Dash on every other Temtem way more easily.[/p][/*][*][p]Remember you will still need to unlock the matching Skill Tree node to play it![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We have l[b]owered the requirements of the Revitalize and Revitalize+ Kudos[/b].[/p][list][*][p]Revitalize: 10000 ➜ 7000[/p][/*][*][p]Revitalize +: 15000 ➜ 10000[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Damaging Status Conditions[/b] can now [b]damage bosses[/b] and mini-bosses:[/p][list][*][p]Freeze, Burn and Poison will now have effective damage ticks over Bosses and mini-bosses.[/p][/*][*][p]Extra effects, like slowing, lowering defense or lowering armor, won’t apply to Bosses and mini-bosses.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]👥Bosses now give a final [b]Pansun reward[/b] when they’re defeated![/p][list][*][p]These Pansuns are divided between all players when playing in Co-op.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]👥We’ve adjusted [b]Dashes[/b] so they can [b]inflict Status Conditions without the need to deal damage[/b] to the Swarm.[/p][list][*][p]You [b]no longer[/b] will need to have the [b]Skill Tree node of Dashes dealing damage unlocked[/b] to inflict Status Conditions on enemies.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]👥All items[/b], including the two Magnets, have been [b]returned to Chests[/b], and now have a chance of appearing in the rewards from them.[/p][list][*][p]Apart from the Magnets, we’ve returned the [b]speed boots[/b] and the [b]immunity shields[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]Instead of being automatically applied like they were before, they will now [b]drop onto the map[/b], so the player [b]can choose when[/b] to pick them up.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]👥Breakable items that are [b]outside of the screen[/b]/view of the player will no longer [b]break[/b] even if hit by a Technique.[/p][list][*][p]This is to improve players’ control over the match, as well as to maintain the satisfaction of breaking boxes intact.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Temtem[/b][/p][list][*][p]All Skill Trees have been uncapped further.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve added the [b]Orbit behavior[/b] to Saku, Ukama, and all the Tuwai notes.title: Raiber Joins Temtem: Swarm and Brings the Heat (Literally!)
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Tamers! [/h1][p]
Get ready to feel the heat! [b]Raiber[/b] is charging headfirst into Temtem: Swarm with fiery claws, sharp fangs, and a chip on its shoulder. This little lion cub is scrappy, spicy, and just dangerous enough to burn itself into your roster of favorites. Whether you’re soloing waves or teaming up with friends to survive the swarm, Raiber brings a new playstyle that rewards risk and aggression. Low on HP? That’s when the real damage starts.[/p][p][/p][h2]Raiber 101[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/62a6aaefbc91eccf2bbf8667d1b6705c4149b80d.png"][/img][/p][h2]Let's Talk Techs[/h2][p]Raiber isn’t your average Temtem. It’s a high-risk, high-reward powerhouse that thrives on danger. Hanging by a thread? Good. That’s when it bites back the hardest. With a mix of explosive Fire techniques and a splash of Nature utility, Raiber can go full brawler or pivot into support when needed. It's flexible, but an aggressive playstyle is where it shines.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Fire Techniques[/h3][p][b]Fire Bite:[/b] Your bread-and-butter chomp. Deals solid Fire damage and Burns enemies for ongoing hurt. Fast, reliable, and perfect for clearing out early waves.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/zVeA7M2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Warm Cuddle:[/b] Don’t be fooled by the name, this one’s hot hot hot. Two fiery orbs hover around an enemy, Burn them, and detonate after a few seconds. Great for stacking AoE damage or softening up tougher foes.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/W7BSn8L.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Hellfire:[/b] Call down the inferno. A sweeping wave of heat damages everything around and leaves a lingering ring of flames. Amazing for crowd control and holding choke points.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/W65Z8Cz.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Nature Techniques[/h3][p]You might not expect it from a walking fire hazard, but Raiber’s got a bit of a green thumb too. In Swarm, it can tap into a handful of Nature techniques that bring some handy utility to its otherwise burn-focused kit. Roots slows down enemies and helps you control the crowd. Sharp Leaf dishes out quick chip damage that’s great for thinning out smaller enemies. And if things get too hot (even for Raiber), Revitalize gives you a sneaky way to patch yourself up mid-run.[/p][p][/p][h2]What about that Ultimate?[/h2][p]Now let’s talk about the big finisher: [b]King’s Roar[/b]. This ultimate move is as dramatic as it sounds. Raiber lets loose a bone-rattling roar that damages all enemies in its path and buffs its own Armor. It’s loud, flashy, and incredibly satisfying when you land it right in the middle of a packed wave. But the real kicker? Once the roar wraps up, Raiber heals for some of the total damage it dealt. That means if you time it right, especially when your HP is hanging by a thread, you can turn a clutch play into a full-on comeback. It rewards smart timing and just the right amount of recklessness. Classic Raiber.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/P0OFPU9.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Raiber is a blast to play if you like walking the line between bold and bonkers. Its damage ramps up the closer it is to fainting, making it perfect for tamers who like living dangerously. If you manage to keep Raiber alive long enough to evolve? Raize and Raican take everything fun about it and crank it up to eleven.[/p][p][/p][p]Are you excited to try out Raiber on June 17th when the Endless Inferno patch launches? Let us know in the comments![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2510960/Temtem_Swarm/?utm_source=post&utm_campaign=evergreen&utm_medium=steam"][/dynamiclink][/p][h1]See you in the Swarm, Tamers![/h1][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Crystle’s Evolution Line Brings Defense and Doom to Swarm!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Tamers![/h1] 

The team is hard at work getting all the awesome new features coming in the next patch ready for you. Not sure what we’re talking about? Don’t forget to check out our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2510960/view/506199076171153859?l=english]Living Roadmap[/url] to see what’s on the horizon!

While we wait, let’s talk Tems. Specifically, let’s take a look at one of the beefiest tanks currently stomping around in [i]Temtem: Swarm[/i], our shiny-shelled friend, [b]Crystle[/b], and its evolutions, [b]Sherald[/b] and [b]Tortenite[/b].

[h2]Crystle 101[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/4ba774146958a1c77efecc7782f0063fc635ce70.png[/img]
Crystle isn’t just a beginner Tem anymore. In Swarm, Crystle’s passive toughness becomes a full-on playstyle. Early on, it's your frontline wall, soaking up hits, anchoring your team, and generally refusing to die. It’s the type of Tem you want by your side when things get spicy.

[h2]Let's Talk Techs[/h2]
The Crystle line pulls double duty in [i]Swarm[/i], tapping into both [b]Crystal[/b] and [b]Toxic[/b] technique pools. That means you’re not just tough, you’re tricky. Whether you’re slicing through enemies with razor-sharp crystal attacks or leaving behind toxic pools of chaos, this Tem line is all about [b]holding the line and punishing overreach[/b]. Let’s break down what they bring to the battlefield.

[u]Crystal Techniques[/u]
[list]
[*] Glass Blade: A sharp horizontal strike—quick and clean.
[*] Quartz Shield: A protective barrier that turns taking damage into a boost in armor.
[*] Crystal Spikes: Random AoE burst to zone or punish clusters.
[*] Mineral Hail: Rains down pain over a wide area. Great for crowd control.
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/bcrbE9c.gif[/img]

[u]Toxic Techniques[/u]
[list]
[*] Toxic Waste: Leaves behind a trail of gooey poison. Great for kiting.
[*] Toxic Ink: Splat attack that sticks and poisons.
[*] Pollution: A toxic breath attack that poisons in an arc and can be manually aimed.
[*] Noxious Bomb: Drops heavy, explodes hard. Satisfying and effective.
[*] Venom Spread: If your target is already poisoned, this projectile detonates for AoE chaos.
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/MnPOJdJ.gif[/img]

[h2]What about that Ultimate?[/h2]

Crystle’s ultimate technique is absolutely terrifying. It plants a massive crystalline garden across the battlefield. Any enemies caught in the crystal bloom are Doomed, literally. They’ve got a timer on their heads, and when it hits zero, it’s game over. And here’s the kicker: Crystle heals for each enemy taken out by the Doom. It’s the gift that keeps on giving (and decimating the Swarm).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/f88Sfis.gif[/img]

Whether you’re queuing up with friends or fighting the swarm solo, Crystle’s line is a great backbone for any team. Early on, Crystle helps you survive tight corners. Midgame, Sherald adds tactical depth and zoning potential. And when you finally evolve into Tortenite? You become a walking win condition. Pair them with fast poisoners or support Tems who can buff or heal, and you’ve got a squad that just won’t quit.

How do you play with Crystle? Let us know in the comments!

notes.title: New update in our Living Roadmap! Catch a glimpse of the future of Temtem: Swarm
notes.content:
Hello, Tamers!

How's the swarm-decimating going? We hope you've been enjoying patch 0.6, Zephyruff, Kinu and Omninesia! While we simmer in all the recent additions and improvements, [b]let's place our eyes on the future for a moment[/b], shall we? 

Although we're still hard at work correcting issues and pushing out fixes on 0.6.4, we never stop working on the next step in Temtem: Swarm! You might still remember [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2510960/view/4467102902950821916?l=english]the first instance of our living roadmap[/url], which we shared close to our launch. This time, and with the first big content update live for all of you to play and enjoy, we're ready to show you the [b]updated version of the roadmap[/b]! 

It covers some of the more substantial changes coming in [b]the next big content update, 0.7[/b]! Please be aware that, while we're posting it  and it is totally official, [b]everything here is still subject to change, be replaced or be rescheduled.[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/1d05eea6b4a8fc89b467d21f71446f815e1f4000.jpg[/img]

If you're familiar with us and our future plans, you know [b]we don't include any sort of dates[/b], and we try to keep things [b]open to possible changes[/b]. We're all too familiar with wanting to include a super neat idea halfway in, and we also know issues can arise in the dev process, be it technical or human. But if you're familiar with our vibes, you know [b]there'll be many spoilers as the time gets closer[/b]! For now, what do you think about the title of patch 0.7?

[h2]Endless Inferno[/h2]

It seems like things are heating up around here! What [b]Arena[/b] do you think we'll unveil in this patch, and which [b]Temtem[/b] will be its main character? Let us know your guesses in the comments! Of course, we're also adding [b]new Techniques, Synergies and Gears[/b], but that's not all! We're working hard on some community-requested features (you can spot them thanks to the little 👥 icon!) like [b]clarity improvements to matchmaking[/b], [b]reworks to some Synergies [/b]that aren't feeling all that bopping right now, and one of the biggest issues our players face nowadays: [b]the RNG in the perk pools[/b].

But we've been doing work on our side too, and we're developing the first step in the [b]Challenge Modes[/b], with more modes and improvements added in further patches, as well as a totally new [b]ping system[/b] to help you play co-op more cooperatively, flashy new [b]cinematics[/b] for pivotal moments in the run, and new [b]Kudos and achievements[/b]!

Remember Temtem: Swarm is still in Early Access, and as such, open to your feedback and suggestions! Please let us know [url=https://discord.gg/DjjAmydpeb]in our Discord server,[/url] although please search around first to see if someone has proposed the same thing. We do our best to read everything, even though we cannot reply to the majority of it, and it helps us shape Temtem: Swarm into a fantastic game. [b]Thank you for your energy and help![/b]

We hope you'll continue to enjoy Temtem: Swarm and support it as we progress in its development and get closer to a bombastic game.

Until then, see you soon Tamers, and…

Temtem Up!

notes.title: Meet Kinu: The newly-arrived Fairy Godparent in Temtem: Swarm!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Tamers![/h1]

Patch 0.6 launched at the start of the month, and we can now safely talk about it without spoiling anybody! Get ready to know more about Kinu, the forest protector that will keep you and your team safe and sound!

[h2]Kinu 101[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/F69qOh5.png[/img]
[h2]Let's Talk Moves[/h2]

Kinu’s playstyle is all about helping others around it, and itself, by keeping the Swarm controlled and under wraps and the health bars topped up. Albeit squishy, every time it revives it becomes more durable by increasing its Max HP, so you can be a bit daring even despite its fragility.

With Kinu’s introduction into the game, that also brought a slew of Nature techniques, so let’s dive into those:

[b]Resin Trap[/b]
A gooey nightmare for enemies where Kinu scatters resin that deals damage and locks the swarm in place, making them an easier target for Kinu and its allies. Not the kind of sticky situation they were hoping for!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vmAPRRQ.gif[/img]

[b]Roots[/b]
A tangle of trouble! These creeping roots slow down enemies and deal constant damage. Kinu’s way of saying, “Take it easy... or else.”
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GwGFYZ1.gif[/img]

[b]Revitalize [/b]
Kinu’s signature support move! A healing zone that restores health to both Kinu and any allies inside. Because teamwork makes the dream work. Don’t miss out on its powerful synergy that knocks enemies out of the healing area, giving you and your teammates some respite.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vZgAjeN.gif[/img]

[b]Sharp Leaf[/b]
When healing isn’t enough, Kinu hurls a razor-sharp leaf at enemies. Remember, never underestimate the dangers of Nature!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LLrDu2k.gif[/img]

Being a dual type Tem, Kinu has access to techniques from the Mental side of things. So, it can also be a pure powerhouse of damage using techniques like Ignis Fatuus and Psy Wave.

[h2]What about that Ultimate?[/h2]
The ultimate gamble, and the move that really drives Kinu’s playstyle home, [b]Vital Power[/b]! Kinu sacrifices most of its own health, dropping to 15%, but in return, it unleashes a devastating blast that hits everything in sight. Risky? Yes. Worth it? Absolutely. Plan carefully, as with great power comes great responsibility.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mRO2F5n.gif[/img]

We hope we piqued your interest towards this particular forest guardian and its tremendous value against the Swarm! This is all we’re sharing about Kinu today, but we definitely encourage you to take Nature into your own hands by choosing Kinu in your next Temtem: Swarm match. Will you be your teammates’ angle, or the Swarm’s devil?

See you next time when we crack open the Temtem vault and unleash another awesome Tem for you to master in Temtem: Swarm!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2510960/Temtem_Swarm/?utm_source=post&utm_campaign=evergreen&utm_medium=steam

As always…

notes.title: Meet Zephyruff: The Speedy New Threat in Temtem: Swarm!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Tamers![/h1] 

Launch day for Patch 0.6 is just around the corner, and you know what that means - spoilers! Get ready to meet Zephyruff, the speedy floof that's joining the Temtem: Swarm roster.

[h2]Zephyruff 101[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/d4pfxzb.png[/img]
[h2]Let's Talk Moves[/h2]

Zephyruff's playstyle is all about speed. Their Trait converts a percentage of speed into damage, and you can increase that percentage through their Skill Tree.

Zephyruff’s starting technique, Wind Trail, is the perfect move to take advantage of their need for speed. As you Speed Racer your way through the Swarm, any Tems that try to follow you will get hit with constant wind damage as they move through the trail. Here’s a sneak peek at Wind Trail:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uP1wYZt.gif[/img]

Zephyruff also gets access to all the Toxic and Wind techniques already in the game, which you can unlock by playing matches with Platypet, Pigepic, and Crystle. And in Patch 0.6, there's a new Toxic technique: Venom Spread!

This new Toxic technique adds a whole new dimension to attacking the Swarm. The priority here is to make sure as many enemy Tems around you as possible have the poison status effect applied to them, so that when Venom Spread hits it causes a chain reaction of explosions and more instances of poisoned Tems. The more Tems that have the Poisoned status effect, the more likely you are to cover the screen in contaminated Tems.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SpnPntF.gif[/img]

New Techniques mean new Synergies, so don’t forget to discover what Gear pairs up perfectly with these new Techniques and unlocks their powerful Synergies! Not seeing the synergy option pop up? You know the drill by now - make sure to check the Skill trees and Kudos board to find out how to unlock them!
[h2]What about that Ultimate?[/h2]
Zephyruff and Volarend's Ultimate, Wind Burst, takes their speed to the next level. Watch them dash through the swarm and leave a trail of defeated Tems in their wake!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/TrIITJM.gif[/img]

Zephyruff and Volarend bring a whole new speed-based strategy to Temtem: Swarm. Whether you like fast assassins or controlling the battlefield with Wind and Poison, this duo is ready to shake things up.

Are you ready to take Zephyruff for a spin when Patch 0.6 drops? Let us know what you think of these new moves!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2510960/Temtem_Swarm/?utm_source=post&utm_campaign=evergreen&utm_medium=steam

See you in the Swarm, Tamers!

Hello, Tamers! We have some news regarding[b] the launch of patch 0.6[/b] for Temtem: Swarm, which is a [b]content update[/b] and not a polish one!

Our goal is to [b]release patch 0.6 in the first half of March[/b], which means we're aiming at the [b]first or second week[/b]! With all the new content and changes to major features in this patch, we want to be optimistic, but have to keep the [b]possibility open for delays[/b] in case something unexpected happens during this final stage of testing, polishing and re-balancing. We're [b]not planning[/b] to go any [b]further than the month of March[/b], though!

We're, of course,[b] working on a specific date[/b], and [b]as soon as we have it we'll provide it[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/dd1ea5a4042e985aed89c59d63ae15015f2ac1b4.jpg[/img]
 
[h2]Content update means new things![/h2]

If you've been following around for a bit, you already know of two big things coming with patch 0.6: [url=https://crema.gg/crema/take-a-look-at-the-upcoming-new-arena-omninesia/]a new Arena, Omninesia[/url], and [url=https://crema.gg/temtem-swarm/matchmaking-will-soon-land-in-temtem-swarm/]random Matchmaking[/url]. With this new Arena you'll be able to enjoy [b]two new playable Tems[/b]! We'll be spoiling one of them in the upcoming days, so I'd keep an eye out on [url=https://linktr.ee/PlayTemtem]our communication avenues [/url]if I were you. We're also trying out the [b]new minimum match duration[/b] that [url=https://crema.gg/temtem-swarm/new-minimum-match-length-20-minutes/]you voted for, [b]20 minutes[/b][/url], so the experience is surely going to be different from what you've played so far!

But there's something else we've come to share spoilers for today: [b]Spots![/b]

Patch 0.6 comes with a [b]handful of completely new spots[/b], [b]many of them suggested by the community[/b] itself! But beyond adding new Spots that players can enjoy, we've also [b]reworked[/b] three of the old ones to make them more fun, more rewarding and/or more challenging, also following community feedback.

Want to see a very relevant spot that got changed? Peep this:

[previewyoutube=gjOkMssIfX0;full][/previewyoutube]
 
The Swarm is getting closer, Tamers! We're already working on the [b]bug-fixing and polishing[/b] stages of patch 0.6, and we're eager to conquer these feats and present you the newest level of Temtem Swarming. You're going to love it!

Get your Skill Trees reviewed and gear up with your co-op mates, for Temtem: Swarm's next patch is coming next month!


Temtem up, Tamers!

notes.title: New minimum match length: 20 minutes!
notes.content:
Hi Tamers! We're here with the announcement that the [b]minimum match length in Temtem: Swarm has been updated from 15 minutes to 20 minutes[/b]. Let's talk about it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/124fb3976864ab4584a0b57fd63c0a4e150b4c8e.jpg[/img]

[h3]A decision based on your feedback[/h3]
Ever since Temtem: Swarm launched in Early Access we've made it clear that we wanted to integrate your feedback into the game as often as possible, and that we were aware of how much fine-tuning a game in this genre requires. We're committed to it, and so we'd been paying attention to feedback provided by players that 15-minute matches were falling on the shorter side, ending just as players were feeling the rush of excitement from finished builds and OP strategies. However, we also had received many opinions on how good the 15-minute matches were, how refreshing compared to the genre standard of 30 minutes, and that it was perfect for a quick run before heading out.

To that end, we conducted internal tests with matches that lasted 20 minutes to assess the situation, and we found it efficiently solved the feedback points raised that matches ended just as you were starting to really enjoy yourself. We consider match brevity a unique part of Temtem: Swarm, one that sets it apart from the rest of the genre, so we weren't considering 30-minute matches, but this middle ground felt like a great compromise between our ideas and the feedback we had received.

However, since the topic was so important and would end up affecting every match played on Temtem: Swarm, we didn't think it was a decision we should make on our own. We extended the question to you through [url=https://forms.gle/VgUwmo1ZfS6RkPLP7]this Google Form[/url] (that has since stopped receiving answers, please don't try to vote now!) and shared it across all our communication avenues. You answered our call and responses poured in, up to 1.576 by the time we closed the poll on February 11th! You also gave us a lot of arguments, pros and cons of each decision, and we did our best to read them all.

[h3]The result[/h3]
The result was that [b]64.4%[/b] of the Tamers who answered our call want to [b]give the 20-minute matches a try[/b], and we're ready to follow that and actually try it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/d826b9b916801c522d360906af02509967077230.png[/img]

With a change like this, some other pieces had to be adjusted as well. The first [b]mini-bosses will appear at 5 and 10 minutes[/b] respectively, while the[b] final boss[/b] of the arena will spawn at [b]20 minutes[/b].  The final boss is what marks the minimum duration of a match, since it has to be defeated for the match to conclude. The actual length of the match will depend on how long you take to defeat the boss, so we can only talk guarantee a minimum of 20 minutes.

As for minute 15, we didn't want to leave it hanging because the run could end up feeling monotonous. 
We've decided to introduce[b] special waves at minute 15[/b] that change the flow of the game and alter the mood a little. [b]Every arena has a different wave 15[/b], so players can experience extra diversity between arenas. These special waves will [b]last until minute 20[/b], and they will blend with common waves. To give you an example, there's an Arena where many Powerful Tems spawn at minute 15, but as you defeat them, the usual enemy Swarm will also continue spawning, reaching a point where you experience the usual Swarm plus the special gimmick of the Arena! 

[h3]Why not both?[/h3]
We are completely aware that giving players the choice to select match duration would be the most rad option, but like with many rad things in game development, it would take massive amounts of time and resources. Balancing and configuring every match duration so all can be equal would be really complex, and even with our best efforts it'd be almost impossible to make them evenly profitable for players. Even past this point, the QA team would need [b]twice as much time[/b] to test everything on separate match duration, which in turn would cause delay on how often we can publish patches.

With the game growing more complex and complete with every patch, we don't have forces to spare! So we're not trying out this route, Tamers, sorry.

[h3]When is the change taking place?[/h3]
[b]This change will take place with patch 0.6[/b], which is the [b]upcoming next patch[/b] for Temtem: Swarm, launching soon! This new patch includes random matchmaking, a new arena, two new playable Tems and a bunch of enemy Tems, including new mini-bosses and a boss, some more features that we're keeping a secret, a lot of quality of life improvements, and bug fixes and polishes! We hope you'll love it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/dd1ea5a4042e985aed89c59d63ae15015f2ac1b4.jpg[/img]

[h3]And an Endless mode?[/h3]
An Endless mode is planned and confirmed for Temtem: Swarm! This mode will be [b]included in the game as part of the Challenge Modes[/b], which are planned for [b]upcoming patches[/b], so we want you to envision it but know there's still some time to go. Please be patient with us as we progress with the content and the Early Access phase! The Endless mode will come in due time.



We understand this is a big change for all Swarm players, so we'll be closely reading your feedback and opinions once you try it. Since we're still in early Early Access, we have a lot of space to maneuver and iterate on any changes we make that don't fit the game or its players. 
So please [url=https://discord.gg/DjjAmydpeb]let us know what you think of this change or any others[/url] when you get to put it to the test!We're now in full preparation for the launch of 0.6, so spoilers are going to keep on coming! 

Stay tuned so you don't miss anything, and may you swiftly conquer the Swarm, Tamers! Bye bye!

notes.title: Matchmaking in Temtem: Swarm — everything you need to know!
notes.content:
Helloooooo Tamers! After months of requests for it, we are glad to officially announce [b]online Matchmaking is coming to Temtem: Swarm soon[/b]!

We initially did not support, or consider including random matchmaking for two main reasons: it was a huge technical feat, or so it seemed. Work on it was tough, and it required a ton of effort on GGTech's and our side. Once on the task, we realized it was something we could manage and lead to fruition; the second reason, we didn't believe playing with other random players would be cooperative enough, and we feared it would lead to disgruntling situations. This, you'll have to tell us yourselves once you try it out in patch 0.6. All that said, after the overwhelming feedback we've received, we've decided to give it a try! 
That's what Early Access is all about after all: being able to make changes based on players' feedback.

[h2]How is it going to work?[/h2]
Very simple! First, let's look at how it will work [b]if you're the one creating the lobby[/b]:First you'll have to select whether you want your lobby to be [b]public or private[/b]. It will be set to public by default,  but you can simply untick the checkbox to make it private. The host of the match will still be the only one who can make changes to the lobby, like choosing a map or turning experience share on and off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/298ecfda655c91cc29e96e48a1344e1f2ea826de.png[/img]

If you'd rather play your match only with people you have invited or shared the code with, simply uncheck the box and invite your friends the traditional ways! 

If you have set the lobby to public, other players looking for a match will be added to your lobby automatically! The game prioritizes people who are close to you, and then broadens out the range as it goes. This system was set in place to ensure you have the best possible experience in terms of connection, and to minimize lag issues. 
The game will also try to match you with other players that have a similar level of experience to yours. This is measured by how many maps they have completed!

If you're the one [b]looking to play a quick match[/b] of Swarm with Strangers, you just have to choose to [b]find a match[/b] instead of joining a lobby. The game, following the rules mentioned before, will match you with a fitting player who has a public lobby open! If you're looking to play with someone you know, or if you have been provided a code, choose [b]join lobby[/b] and enter the code as you were doing before. If you end up changing your mind and prefer to pair up with unknown people, you can still choose to find a match on the same screen, instead of entering a code.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/494a40545ec8d17f1b45ed8e2f2a408e13790be8.jpg[/img]

If you are, for whatever reason, kicked out of a lobby, you will not be matched into that lobby again.

[h2]When!!!???!?!?![/h2]
We've been working extra hard on this feature, since it was the most requested one by our players, and because we believe cooperative playing is really enjoyable, and want everyone to have every chance to experience it. So we're happy to announce it'll be ready for patch 0.6, our upcoming patch! We've already shared some snippets of [url=https://crema.gg/crema/take-a-look-at-the-upcoming-new-arena-omninesia/]the first arena you'll unlock, Omninesia[/url], so consider checking it out if you haven't! 

As you know, spoilers increase as the updates get closer, so we'll see you soon with more info! 

Until then, good luck with the Swarm and Temtem up!

notes.title: Patch 0.5.3
notes.content:
[h1]Important notice[/h1]

Hi Tamers! Although today's patch is an improvements and fixes one, we're hard at work on our next content update, and we'll share a sneak peek —almost a preview!— next week! So as usual, stay tuned!

Some content from the future 0.6 update made its way into this update accidentally, on the Saipark map. That content has now been removed, and it will be added back to the game on patch 0.6, as intended. We apologize for the inconveniences.

[h1]New stuff[/h1]
[list] 	[*]👥 New setting: Dash direction.[list] 	[*]You can now choose whether you want to dash in the direction the Temtem is moving (the default one so far), or in the direction you're aiming.[/*] 	[*]If you're not actively aiming, it will resort to the movement direction.[/*] 	[*]You can switch between these two options anytime in the Settings menu. The movement direction dash is the default option.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list] 	[*]👥 The Block feature will no longer consume your choice for that level up![list] 	[*]You can now block a perk and still choose a reward from the remaining available ones.[/*] 	[*]The perk you've blocked will still take up its slot, so you'll choose from the remaining, pre-existing ones you had gotten.[/*] 	[*]You can only use one block per level up screen.[/*] 	[*]If you choose to reroll after having blocked a perk, you'll get all new options, including the [b]slot[/b] (not the perk you'd blocked, but a new one) you hade previously blocked.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]We've made some adjustments to the way Skill Tree Nodes that can be discovered but not unlocked are presented.[list] 	[*]Up until now, some Nodes unlockable by completing Kudos could be viewed but not reached because other locked Nodes were in the way. This was part of progression, and it was intended that they were not reachable just yet, but it created a negative feeling on players of seeing something and not being able to get to it.[/*] 	[*]We've now locked those Nodes just like the ones not yet in-game, and they'll be unlocked and available once their surrounding Nodes are.[/*] 	[*]We hope this will help improve the feeling while we work on adding more Nodes and more content![/*][/list][/*] 	[*]We have reworked Aohi's Sacred Pillars so the previsualization of the chains informs players that they deal damage.[/*] 	[*]We've given Water Cannon and Water Cannon+ a visual rework![list] 	[*]Since this is one of our first Techs ever, we felt it was a bit lackluster compared to the new ones, so we've given it a glow up![/*] 	[*]We've also taken this chance to make the water torrents a bit more transparent, so they are not as intrusive as before.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]We have adjusted Tentacle Slash's tentacles so they don't appear under terrain anymore.[/*][/list] 

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list] 	[*]👥Fixed being unable to level up or open boxes in a co-op run if we had leveled up on close timing with fainting or reviving.[/*] [*]Fixed players being unable to level up if Crystle applied its ultimate Technique to a Boss or Miniboss[/*] [*]Fixed a softlock and an error after changing Save Profile and trying to create a Co-op lobby.[/*]	[*]👥Fixed getting stuck in a tree in Arbury by using Dash.[/*] 	[*]👥Fixed getting stuck in some areas in Tucma by using Dash.[/*] [*]Fixed being able to activate spots while in Ghost mode[/*]	[*]👥Fixed that Toxic Waste would no longer leave the intended toxic trail behind if our Temtem evolved.[/*] 	[*]Fixed being able to navigate the game with the Backup pop-up open.[/*] 	[*]Fixed seeing water react as if the Boss of that map were still in it if we re-enter a map after defeating the Boss.[/*] 	[*]Fixed a mysterious black line in Tucma.[/*][/list] 

[i]Fixes, features, and improvements marked with the 👥 icon are originally suggested, inspired by, or reported by our community in our [url=http://discord.gg/Temtem]Discord server [/url]and [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/PlayTemtem/]subreddit[/url].[/i]

notes.title: We're looking for new spot ideas, and we wanna hear from you!
notes.content:
Hello Tamers! We'd love to get your input and ideas for [b]new spots[/b], also known as events. These are the events that pop around the map at random intervals, which you can complete solo or with others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890008/bcb967e6cbcf38b79343ce082f9011f96607abea.png[/img]

As you might know, [b]we're working on reworking them[/b] a little, but we also [b]want to hear new and fresh ideas[/b] you might have for [b]new ones[/b]! Here are some rules so we can both make the most of it.

[list]
[] ONLY new ideas. Please do not talk about reworking or improving pre-existing ones. You can create a separate discussion post for it.
[] One or two ideas per post! This way people can react to specifically what they like, and it'd be much simpler for us to examine each suggestion.
[*] Please, no debating in here! We would like to approach this as a list, rather than have to sift through hundreds of replies. If you like or dislike someone's suggestion, you can gift them a community icon!
[/list]

Thank you in advance for all your ideas, let your creative juices flow and have fun!
